project_type: DEMAze Technologies marketing website — TanStack Start (SSR) on Vite 8, React 19, Tailwind v4, TypeScript, Supabase-backed forms, deployed to Railway (Nitro node-server preset)
build_system: Vite 8 via @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config wrapper. Do NOT add tanstackStart/react/tailwind/nitro/tsConfigPaths plugins manually in vite.config.ts — the wrapper already includes them and duplicates break the app. Nitro preset overridden to node-server.
test_framework: vitest (vitest run). Tests live next to source: src/lib/site-data.test.ts, src/lib/submission-guards.test.ts. jsdom + @testing-library available.
verification_instructions: README + CI define exactly four checks that must pass: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint (eslint .), npm test (vitest run), npm run build (vite build). CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs npm ci then all four on push/PR.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/assets/images.ts is generated by scripts/optimize-images.mjs (npm run images) and MUST NOT be hand-edited. Regenerating requires the sharp dependency and the source art in src/assets/original/. src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by the router plugin at build time.
setup_instructions: npm install; npm run dev (serves http://localhost:8080).
environment_constraints: SANDBOX: network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. node_modules is NOT present and `npm install` fails (public npm registry unreachable; offline install has no cache). Additionally the sandbox forces NODE_OPTIONS=--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js which does not exist, so even bare `node`/`npm` invocations error unless NODE_OPTIONS is cleared, and they still cannot reach the registry. THEREFORE the four quality checks (typecheck/lint/test/build) CANNOT be run locally in this sandbox and must be validated by CI, which has network access. Make edits that are type-correct and lint-clean by construction (match existing patterns exactly). Do NOT attempt long-running npm install/build commands — they will time out.
contribution_requirements: Branch syncs to Lovable (see AGENTS.md): keep the branch in a WORKING state at every commit; never force-push, rebase, amend, or squash already-pushed commits. Work happens on branch fix/production-audit (already created). Do NOT commit directly to main. The orchestrator handles push/PR.
key_patterns: Content (metrics, projects, services, industries, faqs, process, values) is centralized in src/lib/site-data.ts as `as const` arrays. UI reads them via named imports. Images spread {...image} (src/width/height) onto to prevent layout shift. Scroll animations are rAF-gated with a single getBoundingClientRect read per frame and always guard `prefers-reduced-motion`. Reduced-motion and matchMedia guards are used throughout. Server functions in src/lib/forms.functions.ts use createServerFn + zod validators + submission-guards (rate limit + honeypot + timing). Prettier enforced via eslint-plugin-prettier — match existing formatting (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas).
relevant_files: src/lib/site-data.ts (metrics array at ~line 508, the placeholder homepage numbers)
src/routes/index.tsx (hero floating badge '35+ Tech Architects', 'Who we are' 35+ copy, MetricsStrip)
directory_structure: src/routes/ (10 file-based routes), src/components/ (feature components + ui/ primitives), src/lib/ (site-data, forms.functions, submission-guards + tests, error-capture/error-page/lovable-error-reporting), src/assets/ (original/ source art + generated images.ts + hero video), src/server.ts (SSR wrapper + CSP + asset caching), src/styles.css (single 86KB stylesheet, Tailwind v4 @custom-variant dark declared at line 10 but no .dark token set).
